markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the US personal saving rate for 2026 is at least 4.0%, as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by Federal Reserve Economic Data, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For purposes of this market, “personal saving rate” refers to FRED series PSAVERT, Personal Saving Rate, for December 2026. This value is reported as a percent, seasonally adjusted annual rate, and is sourced by FRED from the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis.

This market will use the first value published by Federal Reserve Economic Data for December 2026. Revisions released after the first publication of the December 2026 value will not be considered.
markets.title: Will US personal saving rate for 2026 be at least 4.0%?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if any qualifying BEA Personal Income and Outlays release covering a 2026 reference month reports the personal saving rate below 2%.
markets.rules_primary: If the US personal saving rate is reported below 2.0% in any Bureau of Economic Analysis Personal Income and Outlays release covering a 2026 reference month, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The “US personal saving rate” means the monthly personal saving rate reported by the Bureau of Economic Analysis, defined as personal saving as a percentage of disposable personal income.

This market resolves based on the first value reported for each 2026 reference month in the corresponding BEA Personal Income and Outlays release. Later revisions do not affect settlement.
markets.title: Will US personal saving rate for 2026 be below 2.0%?
